failure_modes.recovery: If this is genuinely a second expense, retry the identical call with force: true.
failure_modes.when: an expense with the same amount on the same date already exists (potential_duplicate: true)

failure_modes.recovery: Call expense_category_list (run expense_category_ensure_defaults first if it is empty) and retry with a real id.
failure_modes.when: category_id does not name an expense_category in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Create it as 'draft' (or omit status) and submit it with expense_submit; admin/owner creators may pass 'approved'.
failure_modes.when: status 'approved' was supplied by a creator below admin

failure_modes.recovery: Reach 'pending' via expense_submit and 'rejected'/'reimbursed' via their transition doors after creation.
failure_modes.when: status is not an entry state (only 'draft' and 'approved' can be born), or an approval stamp field was supplied

preconditions: status entry contract (honor-or-refuse): omit it and the platform picks by role (admin/owner → 'approved', member → 'draft'); a supplied 'draft' is honored for every role, 'approved' is honored for admin/owner and refused below — never silently overridden.
expense_date omitted = today. tags_json must be a JSON array of strings when present.

description: Logs a new expense — amount_cents must be integer CENTS (a decimal string via `amount` also works, and `category` resolves to a category_id by name). A same-amount, same-UTC-day duplicate for the same user is refused as CONFLICT unless you resend identically with force: true. Status is honor-or-refuse: admin/owner creators land 'approved' by default (or may request it explicitly), everyone else always starts 'draft'. NEXT: expense_submit sends a draft into the approval queue.

amount.description: Decimal money STRING ("23.50") — the platform converts; integer CENTS ($23.50 → 2350) via amount_cents is also accepted.

category.description: Category by name or slug, e.g. 'food'.

category_name.description: Alias of category — resolves to category_id by name or slug.

cost.description: Alias of amount — same decimal money STRING parsing.

description.description: Alias of notes — used only when notes is not also supplied.

force.description: Resend an identical expense_create with force: true to save it despite a same-amount, same-UTC-day duplicate match; omitted or false leaves the duplicate check refusing with CONFLICT.

total.description: Alias of amount — same decimal money STRING parsing.

name: expense_create
